provisioning.description: Display names for PingOne-provisioned apps and resource servers. Keys are internal JS object keys; values are the names provisioned into PingOne.

aliases.description: External-spelling -> canonical-manifest-scope map. Reconciles scope spellings used outside the manifest (PingGateway env, OAuth /authorize) with the canonical scope declared in scopes{}. Keys are the external spelling; values MUST be a scope declared in scopes{}.

deployment.description: v3: Public app URLs per deployment environment (non-sensitive). Master SoT for PINGONE_PUBLIC_APP_URL and PINGONE_RESOURCE_PINGGATEWAY_URI. Kept separate from .env (which holds secrets) for better auditability and version control.

pingGatewayResourceUri.description: PingGateway resource server URI (alternate gateway endpoint)

adminCallback.description: Redirect URI path for admin login

userCallback.description: Redirect URI path for user login

category.description: v2: policy-engine scope family. Authoritative for scopePolicyEngine categorization (admin/users -> admin; ai_agent -> ai; default banking).

uri.description: v2: the resource server's audience (PingOne aud). Authoritative — bootstrap creates the RS with this audience.

scopes.description: Scopes native to this resource server (this RS is the canonical owner).

mirroredScopes.description: v2: scopes mirrored onto this RS because it is an RFC 8693 exchange-hop audience. Per ARCHITECTURE-TRUTHS T-10, scope vocabularies are per-resource and do not cascade — a scope traveling through an exchange hop must exist on that hop's audience resource. These are owned (native) by another RS but must also exist here.

type.description: v2: PingOne application type bootstrap should create.

grantTypes.description: v2: OAuth grant types for this app (e.g. authorization_code, client_credentials, token_exchange).

isResourceServer.description: v2: if this app IS a resource server (its inbound token aud target), the resource name it corresponds to. Used to wire app -> RS audience.

servers.description: v2: per-runtime-service model — which resource the service owns/validates and what it gates on. Documents the deployment topology so bootstrap + audits derive server expectations from one place.

resource.description: The resource server whose audience this service validates inbound tokens against.

validatesAudience.description: The aud value this service requires on inbound tokens (normally the resource's uri).

gatesOnToolScopes.description: True if this service enforces per-tool requiredScopes (e.g. the MCP Gateway). Implies every gateway-surface tool scope must be mirrored onto this server's resource.

policy.description: Authorization policy constants shared by every engine (simulated, mock authz-server, P1AZ snapshot). Read by scopeTopology.js threshold accessors.

highValueConsentThresholdUsd.description: Amount above which HITL consent is required ($250 default).

stepUpThresholdUsd.description: Amount above which MFA step-up is required ($500 default).

amountLimitsByTier.description: Hard per-tier amount ceilings (e.g. standard: 2000, privatebanking: 50000).

a2aDelegated.description: True when this sensitive tool is reachable ONLY via A2A specialist delegation — PingOne Authorize DENYs unless the token's act chain shows a specialist delegated by the generalist (depth >= 2). The generalist cannot call it directly.

a2aDelegatedScope.description: The specialist scope the A2A-delegated token must carry to reach this tool (e.g. 'records:read'). Paired with a2aDelegated: true.

requiresAgentMediation.description: True when this tool requires agent mediation (HITL consent or step-up) before execution.
